tools.name: stye_search_tracks
tools.description:
Searches the Songs To Your Eyes production-music catalogue for cues that fit a brief for a video, film, advert, trailer or podcast: music to license for a project, or anything about the Songs To Your Eyes catalogue.

The brief is matched by MEANING against an editorial description of how each cue be

tools.name: stye_fit_to_duration
tools.description:
Finds cues that fit an exact runtime, for a cut of known length such as a 30-second advert or a 90-second title sequence: music to license for a project, or anything about the Songs To Your Eyes catalogue.

Two kinds of result come back. Some cues already run close to the target length (fit='native'

tools.name: stye_get_track
tools.description:
Everything about one cue: what it sounds like and suits, its tempo, key, length and instrumentation, every version that exists of it (stems, shorter cuts, alternate mixes) and its listen_url. For a track already found, or for what else a cue can be delivered as.

Every result carries listen_url, a p

tools.name: stye_list_versions
tools.description: Every form a cue can be delivered in: the full-length mix plus, where they exist, timed cutdowns (15, 30, 60 seconds) built for standard ad and promo lengths, alternate mixes such as no-drums, underscore or instrumental for music that sits beneath dialogue, and individual instrument stems for rebala

tools.name: stye_cue_sheet
tools.description: The clearance data a broadcaster or PRO filing needs for one cue: every credited writer with role, society and IPI, every publisher with its share, the ISRC and the album. A field missing from the response is not on file in the catalogue; info@songstoyoureyes.com handles gaps. Licensing is arranged

tools.name: stye_find_similar
tools.description: Cues close in character to a given one, matched on the catalogue's editorial description of each cue together with its genres, moods and instrumentation, for 'more like this one' moments. It compares how cues are described, not their waveforms, so it is strong on character and mood and does not dete

tools.name: stye_about
tools.description: What this service is, how licensing works and what the server sees: the service's own licensing and privacy statements, with links to the full legal terms and the privacy policy.

tools.name: stye_feedback
tools.description: Sends a short message to the catalogue team about how well results fit: a wrong-feeling page, a brief that found nothing, or praise worth keeping. It sends only with consented=true, which records that the user explicitly agreed to send this message; without it, nothing is sent. The message is stored

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "stye_search_tracks" is 7953 chars, far longer than this server's median (463). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "stye_search_tracks" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "stye_search_tracks" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: brief, bpm_min, bpm_max, duration_min_s, duration_max_s, has_vocals, genres, moods, instruments, energy, vo_friendly, composer, album, max_per_album, context, exclude, key, include_previews, limit

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "stye_search_tracks" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
